name: XlSlicerCrossFilterType
description: Specifies the type of cross filtering used by the specified slicer cache and how it is visualized.

constants.name: xlSlicerNoCrossFilter
constants.description: Cross filtering is turned off entirely, so all tiles are displayed and active (not dimmed) regardless of filtering selections in other slicers.

constants.name: xlSlicerCrossFilterShowItemsWithDataAtTop
constants.description: Cross filtering is turned on for this slicer cache, any tile with no data for a filtering selection in other slicers connected to the same data source will be dimmed. Additionally, tiles with data are moved to the top in the slicer. (Default)

constants.name: xlSlicerCrossFilterShowItemsWithNoData
constants.description: Cross filtering is turned on for this slicer cache, any tile with no data for a filtering selection in other slicers connected to the same data source will be dimmed.

constants.name: xlSlicerCrossFilterHideButtonsWithNoData
constants.description: Cross filtering is turned on for this slicer cache, any tile with no data for a filtering selection in other slicers connected to the same data source will be dimmed. Additionally, buttons will be hidden.
